data.notes: May is unusually dense around Seoul, with hip-hop, jazz, indie-pop festivals, arena-scale K-pop, and international electronic club bookings clustered across the month.

events.title: HIPHOPPLAYA Festival 2026
events.summary: Korea’s major hip-hop festival returns near Seoul with a final lineup including Jay Park, E Sens, Crush, Lee Young-ji, C Jamm x Black Nut, Lil Moshpit, and label/project stages.

events.title: UNDERCITY presents Space 92
events.summary: French techno headliner Space 92 plays UNDERCITY with KIMNA, HOZONE, ØNSEMIRO, and SEAN XXX supporting.

events.title: QTOPIA Seoul: HARD MODE DUNGEON
events.summary: RA-listed Cakeshop night focused on bass, hard drum, and high-BPM club sounds, with Hiru, Siyoou_u, Mobymobimo:3, Tanya, Autopilot77_77, DDD, and Saika.

events.title: Forestella — THE LEGACY: SYMPHONY In Seoul
events.summary: Crossover vocal group Forestella brings its fourth-album tour, THE LEGACY: SYMPHONY, to Jangchung Arena for two Seoul dates.

events.title: INVITES: Perfo
events.summary: Faust’s INVITES series hosts Perfo with gezibe and NUSNOOM in the main room, plus Ginger and YAREE in Tanz Bar.

events.title: The 18th Seoul Jazz Festival 2026
events.summary: Seoul’s flagship international jazz festival runs three days at Olympic Park with a 60-act lineup including Janelle Monáe, Herbie Hancock, Jon Batiste, FKJ, Arturo Sandoval, Ezra Collective, and Of Monsters and Men.

events.title: PEAK Festival 2026
events.summary: Two-day outdoor band festival at Nanji Hangang Park, with the final lineup featuring NELL, Jaurim, SPYAIR, Thornapple, QWER, 10CM, Idiotape, and more.

events.title: GLOBAL CALLING: FOUND FREQUENCIES — Lost Frequencies
events.summary: Belgian DJ-producer Lost Frequencies headlines Lion Super Club for a late-night GLOBAL CALLING / FOUND FREQUENCIES party.

events.title: 2026 I.O.I Concert Tour: LOOP in Seoul
events.summary: I.O.I’s 10th-anniversary reunion tour opens with three Seoul concerts at Jamsil Indoor Stadium.

events.title: Beautiful Mint Life 2026
events.summary: The long-running spring indie-pop festival returns to Oil Tank Culture Park for two days, with acts listed across May 30 and May 31 including LUCY, N.Flying, Peppertones, TOUCHED, Car, the Garden, and more.

events.title: SHOW ME THE MONEY 12 Concert
events.summary: Mnet’s Show Me the Money 12 concert brings participating rappers to YES24 Live Hall, with the reported lineup including Kim Ha-on, MILLI, Zene the Zilla, Flowsik, Fleeky Bang, and other season performers.
